text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"What is it? My wake-up dance, of course!
When neither coffee nor energy drinks work,
nothing beats this for intense drowsiness!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"If a hardcore dance gets both mind and body
all fired up, any drowsiness will vanish in a flash—"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No good, I'm even more tired now,
*yawn*, ahh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems her fatigue has built up to the point where her thoughts and actions are out of sync.
We should probably reconsider her race schedule...
